subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit policy notice remain open as the public GitHub-facing announcement now that the 20-PR cap is documented and shipped?
rationale: Closing it would override an explicit maintainer reopen/pin signal rather than resolve missing source work.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice Open
options.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the canonical GitHub policy notice while CONTRIBUTING.md and Barnacle automation enforce the same 20-PR cap.

options.title: Close As Docs-Owned
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide CONTRIBUTING.md and automation are sufficient public policy surfaces.

options.title: Revise The Cap Policy
options.body: If maintainers want a different threshold or exception model, update CONTRIBUTING.md, labeler workflow, Barnacle auto-response, and tests together.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and pinned as the canonical GitHub policy notice while CONTRIBUTING.md and Barnacle automation enforce the same 20-PR cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman provided the clearest recent human policy signal by renaming, pinning, and reopening this exact notice.
